The Pioneers are riding a 5-game winning streak and have successfully defended the belt 13 times already in this reign, showing the mettle of a championship-caliber squad. Michigan's 4-0 start is impressive, but facing a Denver team that beat them 4-3 in the playoffs just six months ago presents a different challenge. The Elo model backing Denver at home, combined with their head-to-head dominance, suggests the belt stays in the Mile High City in what should be another tight, one-goal affair.
